trim_trailing_whitespace #

Whether trailing whitespace is removed from every line. ⚠ jb cleanupcode ignores it: probed with = true on a doc comment carrying a trailing space, the oracle returns the space. Skala matches the oracle rather than the key, so it is inert in both directions.
